svg.aria-label: Arena. The room decides. Contests decided by the people physically in the room: the prize is locked in an Ethereum contract before the first vote and the contract pays the winner when voting closes. Sepolia testnet, verified contract, 227 contract, 646 web and 44 end-to-end tests.
